note: Belarusbank's 'Infinite Card' credit: the card is issued and serviced free for its term; after the grace period, credit applied for at a branch bears the National Bank's refinancing rate plus 8.4 points, variable, which the page gives as the top of its range, 17.65% a year. The reduced rates within a grace period of one to five months are introductory and not written. On 2026-10-30 the range was widened to the main banks: Belarusbank, Belagroprombank and Priorbank, the largest retail lenders. Belarusbank's consumer-credit list (read 2026-10-30) has no other credit card than the Infinite Card; the rest are loans and overdrafts. Priorbank's credit card page (read 2026-10-30): its Кредитная карточка Visa, a revolving credit line of 300 to 55,000 roubles at 18.65% a year, issued free with no compulsory paid services; each month 2% of the debt on the 1st plus the month's interest is due, written as the minimum. Its penalty of 0.03% of the overdue sum for each day late isn't modelled (the game charges a late fee once, not by the day). Belagroprombank's site serves its pages behind Cloudflare and gave no card page at the address tried (404); BPS-Sberbank's and MTBank's refused the connection; none is written.
